concept.title: Categories not yet in a group
concept.shortdesc: These categories sit alone in the clustering hierarchy, so the grouping step named no group for them. A person deciding the final structure would place each one.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Sessions restricted to one gender, such as women-only, ladies-only, girls-only or boys-only, including related conditions about partners or recognised gender.
: Being registered with a GP in a stated area, or having an NHS connection such as being NHS staff or treated at a named hospital.
: Restricted to fully paid-up members of a specific membership organisation.
: Pupils who attend, or whose school is in partnership with, a named school or group of schools.
: Living in a very local area defined by a specific street, estate or housing area within a town.
: Being on a low income, in financial hardship, or in receipt of means-tested benefits.
